name: Hard Pack
description: The Hard Pack is a set of challenging word search puzzles for adults who want reverse words, diagonals and denser grids. Free online, with no timer and no account. Word lists stay general and grown-up — vocabulary of focus, craft, weather and quiet places — so you can settle in for a longer session. If large print feels better on some days, visit our Large Print Pack instead; otherwise open a hard puzzle here and take your time.
